samples.question: All four mosaics are woven into one uninterrupted navy atlas; a hole in the atlas makes it unreadable. The large 6-by-6 mosaic is divided into nine outlined 2-by-2 blocks. Reduce each block to one tile, in the same row and column: the result is cyan exactly when that block contains exactly two cyan tiles that share a side; otherwise it is cream. Which red, green, or blue tag marks the exact 3-by-3 result?
